links.name: RSNA Pneumonia
links.use: Testing: zero-shot ACC, AUC and F1 against ConVIRT, CLIP, SLIP and DeCLIP; CMKR ACC 0.501 (COVID-19) and 0.649 (RSNA); ablation shows adding the KG raises COVID-19 ACC from 0.279 to 0.501 at 6% more inference time.

links.name: CMKR medical KG (unspecified)
links.use: Testing: zero-shot ACC, AUC and F1 against ConVIRT, CLIP, SLIP and DeCLIP; CMKR ACC 0.501 (COVID-19) and 0.649 (RSNA); ablation shows adding the KG raises COVID-19 ACC from 0.279 to 0.501 at 6% more inference time.

links.name: CheXpert
links.use: Testing: ACC, AUC and F1 on Atelectasis, Cardiomegaly, Consolidation, Edema and Pleural effusion against the same baselines; hourly diagnosis accuracy of medical specialists with and without CMKR; failure-case analysis.

links.name: CMKR medical KG (unspecified)
links.use: Testing: ACC, AUC and F1 on Atelectasis, Cardiomegaly, Consolidation, Edema and Pleural effusion against the same baselines; hourly diagnosis accuracy of medical specialists with and without CMKR; failure-case analysis.

links.name: LSBench
links.use: Testing: throughput (triples per second) of CQELS+ shared joins vs the public CQELS as the number of concurrent queries grows (Fig. 5).

links.name: CityBench
links.use: Testing: end-to-end query latency of CQELS+ under three load-balancing strategies (rotation, minimum average latency, total buffer size) with 1-4 engine instances (Fig. 6), and latency as the number of streams grows (Fig. 7).

links.name: Airbus SIDPs
links.use: Testing: semantic-parsing coverage (97.50% of SIDPs parsed), correctness of derived DL formulae (BLEU of re-generated sentences) and ontology enrichment (798 formulae (85.3%) added; 38 rejected for syntax errors, 9 for inconsistency; Table 5).

links.name: Airbus ontology
links.use: Source: target ontology enriched with the parsed DL formulae; derived classes matched to existing ones (89 cases) or added as new (935 cases), with consistency and unsatisfiable-class checks (HermiT).

links.name: DBpedia
links.use: Testing: adapted vs non-adapted importance measures and Relevance by Spearman correlation with query-log class frequency (Fig. 2a), similarity to reference summaries (Fig. 3b), additional nodes introduced (Fig. 2b) and runtime (Fig. 4).

links.name: ICEWS16-20
links.use: Testing: temporal coverage of TEQA vs TempoQR and CTRN (92% / 74% / 68%; Table 2) and computational efficiency (inference time per query, GPU memory, parameters; Table 7).

links.name: ICEWS14
links.use: Analysis: explainable-validation case study of sanction-event paths (Crimea Annexation E-20140316-001, EU Sanctions E-20140730-005, Germany Sanctions E-20150112-009, US Sanctions E-20141220-003) and explanation-quality ablation (Tables 9-10).

links.name: ICEWS05-15
links.use: Analysis: used to validate long-term dependencies in the explainable-validation study (Sec. 5.10.2).
